verdict.rationale: The docs give a precise context window for each model: the grok-4.7 page states "Context window: 500,000 tokens", and the models/pricing tables carry a per-model Context column (500k, 1M, 256k). GET /v1/models also returns a `context_length` field, and the pricing docs state the 200k-token long-context billing threshold. Nothing in the evidence documents per-model maximum output tokens, so only the input side of the story's "input/output limits" is covered. Missing for 10: per-model max output token limits, a separate input vs. output budget breakdown, independent or hands-on confirmation of the stated limits.
